Join a collaborative IT team where your hands-on experience managing servers, cloud environments, and enterprise systems will be valued every day. This isn’t just a support role – you’ll serve as a senior technical resource, lead infrastructure initiatives, and help shape the systems that keep Experitec running at its best. What truly sets us apart is our culture. Leadership knows employees by name, development is treated as a rock wall — always climbing, always adding new skills — and the work-life balance is real, not just a talking point. If you’re driven, collaborative, and want your technical contributions to matter, Experitec is where you belong. What does a System Administrator do? In This Position You Will Be A trusted technical resource and advanced escalation point for complex IT infrastructure issues across the organization. Administering and maintaining Windows Server and Linux environments to ensure reliability and performance. Managing Active Directory, Azure Active Directory, and Office 365 with advanced policy and compliance configurations. Diagnosing and resolving complex networking issues, including VPN, VLAN, subnetting, and firewall policies. Leveraging virtualization platforms to deploy, manage, and decommission virtual servers. Writing PowerShell scripts and automations to eliminate manual, repetitive tasks. Monitoring system health, responding to alerts, and proactively maintaining enterprise security and up time. Bridging the technical gap between Tier 1/2 helpdesk and senior IT leadership. Mentoring junior IT team members and contributing to technical documentation and SOPs. Participating in infrastructure upgrade, migration, and deployment projects. Experitec is seeking a dynamic systems professional who is passionate about enterprise infrastructure and driven to keep our technology environment secure, stable, and scalable. What You Will Contribute Advanced troubleshooting expertise as the primary escalation point between Tier 1/2 support and senior IT staff. Hands-on management of enterprise servers, storage (SAN/NAS), and virtualization platforms. Automation of routine processes using PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting tools. Secure, reliable administration of cloud environments (Microsoft Azure) and on-premises systems. Implementation of security best practices, vulnerability remediation, and patch management. Technical leadership on infrastructure projects, including migrations, upgrades, and deployments. High-availability and disaster recovery testing to protect business continuity. Documentation of technical procedures and knowledge transfer to empower the broader IT team. Collaboration with network, security, cloud, and application teams on cross-functional initiatives. Key Responsibilities Technical Support & Infrastructure Management Administer and maintain Windows and Linux server environments. Manage and support Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP. Design, implement, and maintain enterprise infrastructure solutions. Administer virtualization platforms. Manage cloud environments (Microsoft Azure). Configure and maintain backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions. Monitor system performance, capacity, and availability while proactively identifying and mitigating risks. Handling Escalations and Root Cause Analysis Provide as an escalation point on complex tickets from Tier 1 and 2. Diagnose the underlying root cause. Investigate deep system logs, network architecture, and application configurations. Bridge the IT gap to other business units. Lead root cause analysis efforts for critical incidents and recurring problems. Managing Infrastructure and High Availability Proactively monitor and optimize enterprise systems. Manage virtualized servers and configure network load balancing. Test disaster recovery and backup systems routinely to ensure maximum uptime. Support high-availability and failover solutions for critical business systems. Perform capacity planning and infrastructure optimization to support business growth. Scripting and Automation Identify ways to eliminate repetitive and manual work. Write complex scripts, such as PowerShell, for Microsoft Entra environments. Automate routine diagnostics, patch management, desktop imaging, and application delivery. Develop and maintain automation scripts using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar tools. Security and Network Maintenance Implement and enforce the overarching security strategies on the ground. Troubleshoot advanced connectivity issues and system outages. Audit directory structures and elevated permissions to maintain a secure environment. Implement security best practices, vulnerability remediation, and system hardening. Monitor and manage patching, updates, and lifecycle maintenance of infrastructure components. Ensure compliance with organizational policies, security requirements, and regulatory standards. Mentoring and Documentation Act as a technical leader and escalation point for the IT department. Mentor junior administrators, Tier 1 and Tier 2 Helpdesk, and analyze ticket escalation trends. One or more years of experience monitoring system performance, capacity, and availability while proactively identifying and mitigating risks. Experience leading root cause analysis efforts for critical incidents and recurring problems. Experience implementing security best practices, vulnerability remediation, and system hardening. Experience monitoring and managing patching, updates, and lifecycle maintenance of infrastructure components. Experience developing and maintaining automation scripts using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar tools. Ability to create and maintain technical documentation, standards, and operating procedures. Experience planning and executing infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and deployment projects. Ability to collaborate with network, security, cloud, and application teams on cross-functional initiatives. Ability to support enterprise storage systems, SAN/NAS technologies, and data management platforms. Ability to configure and maintain monitoring and alerting solutions. Ability to evaluate new technologies and recommend infrastructure improvements. Ability to ensure compliance with organizational policies, security requirements, and regulatory standards. Ability to support high-availability and failover solutions for critical business systems. Ability to perform capacity planning and infrastructure optimization to support business growth. Ability to effectively communicate (written and verbal) with internal customers and co-workers and to provide strong customer support through proactive solution development and time management. Ability to independently travel domestically up to 10% of the time, including overnights. Ability to lift more than 30 lbs. Microsoft certifications (for example: Azure Administrator Associate, Microsoft 365 Certified: or Enterprise Administrator Expert). Experience with SIEM tools and log management platforms. Familiarity with AI-driven security tools for behavioral threat detection, automated incident response, and/or intelligent patch prioritization. Experience supporting enterprise AI integrations within Microsoft 365 environments, including Microsoft Copilot deployment and administration. Understanding of infrastructure requirements for AI and machine learning workloads, including compute, storage, and networking considerations. Experience using AI-assisted scripting and development tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate automation and reduce manual effort. Familiarity with AI-powered AIOps and monitoring platforms for proactive anomaly detection and automated infrastructure remediation.
